blocks.text: Chromatin fibre khud par mur kar supercoil (300 nm moti) banata hai. Supercoil mazeed lipat aur sukar kar chromatid (700 nm mota) ki shakal le leta hai.

blocks.title: Itna lapetna kyun?
blocks.text: Taqreeban 5 cm lambe DNA ko sirf chand micrometre lambe chromosome mein samana hota hai. Socheiye: dhaaga charkhi par lapeta, phir charkhiyon ki rassi bana kar use bhi lapet diya. Nucleosomes aur fibres isi tarah jagah bachate hain.

blocks.prompt: DNA aur histones aapas mein itni mazbooti se kyun jurte hain?
blocks.explanation: DNA par phosphate groups ki wajah se negative charge hai aur histones par arginine aur lysine ki wajah se positive charge. Mukhalif (opposite) charges aik doosre ko khenchte hain.

items: 146 nucleotides octamer ke gird = nucleosome; nucleosome string 11 nm; H1 linker histone.
